substantive_visual.observation: Different plant scales, attached leaf/stem anatomy, root cutaway, pot rims and soil remain substantive across width.

hangul.observation: Explanation has open counters, clear serif bodies and regular word spaces at usage720. Access/care/invitation smaller, around 10–11px visual height.

information_relationship.observation: Explanation leads into nearby market/visit, followed by access/care and invitation/URL. Market/ledger start is still offset right of explanation; ledger floats above specimen ground.

function_contact.observation: URL read verbatim; flat raster URL not interactive. No requested logo/QR.

material_edges.observation: Rich leaf veins and roots retained, pots sharply bounded. Pale diagonal leaf shadows retain greenhouse-scene cues, denser lower growth crowds ledger edge.

observations.observation: The three-line paragraph is larger and darker than the compact identity; intended verbal hierarchy is now visible.
All three lines read with substantially larger syllable bodies and stable line starts; explanation wraps at meaningful word boundaries.
These smaller rows remain around 10–11px and require closer focus than the date row.
Paragraph starts near x210 while market and succeeding ledger start near x300, so the final-to-next common axis remains displaced.
Furniture removed, but paving-like ground, rear foliage and pale wall/shadow cues keep it closer to a greenhouse vignette than independent atlas specimens.
Earlier attached branches, detailed canopy, root-ball section and different pot scales persist.

residuals: Lower access/care/invitation/URL rows remain small at usage720.
Market/ledger start remains displaced from explanation start.
Ledger floats above paving-like specimen ground rather than being carried by an open drawn atlas ground.
Residual greenhouse wall/shadows and dense rear foliage weaken independent atlas organization.
